page.description: Preview first. Choose exactly which contacts belong together.

upload.title: Choose a contact file
upload.sourcePlaceholder: The account or export these contacts came from
upload.sourceHint: Reuse the same source name and address book when importing an updated export.
upload.preservation: Original values and source labels are preserved. No person is created or merged until you save a review decision.
upload.countryHint: Leave blank to retain national phone numbers without normalization.

preview.loading: Reading records and preparing identity evidence…
preview.title: Contact preview
preview.empty: No contact records found. Choose another export.
preview.ready: Preview ready. No people have been imported.

review.reloadHint: Reloading clears unsaved choices. Review the current evidence before deciding again.
review.saved: Decision saved. Deferred candidates remain available for review.
review.choose: Choose who belongs in this merge
review.chooseHint: Select matching contacts. Mark other people separately, or leave them for later.
review.noCandidate: No matching candidate. First names alone never merge automatically.
review.retained: Existing source details are retained. Candidates left for later remain separate.
review.unmaterialized: Both contacts are awaiting import. Create the incoming contact first to continue the comparison.
review.name: Display name

rowIssues.stale_source: This source changed after preview. Upload an updated export before deciding.

errors.invalidRequest: The request was rejected. Check the file or review choices.
errors.unauthorized: Your session is unavailable. Sign in and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to change these contacts.
errors.notFound: The import or contact no longer exists. Reload the evidence.
errors.stale: Contact evidence changed. Reload and review the current evidence.
errors.tooLarge: The export exceeds the 5 MiB limit. Choose a smaller file.
errors.service: The contacts service could not complete the request.
errors.network: Could not reach the contacts service. Retry the request.
errors.invalidResponse: Contacts returned an incomplete response. Reload the evidence.
errors.candidateChanged: Candidate evidence changed. Reload the review.
errors.unmaterialized: Create the matching contact before deciding its identity.
errors.keepSeparate: A remembered different-person decision prevents this merge.
errors.invalidEvidence: Candidate evidence is incomplete. Reload the review.
errors.missingQueue: The incoming contact queue must be loaded before more candidate evidence.
errors.saveFailed: The decision could not be saved.
errors.stageFailed: The export could not be read.
errors.providerChanged: The connection changed or the selected account does not match. Reload connections and reconnect the intended account.

connections.title: Contact connections
connections.description: Connect your accounts, then review the people you bring into POPS.

messages.expired: Access expired. Reconnect this account before preparing an import.

connections.setupHint: Allow read-only access to your contacts. Review matches before importing.
connections.manageHint: Manage your account and prepare the next contact import.
connections.passwordHint: Create an app-specific password in your Apple account settings to connect iCloud Contacts.
connections.googleHint: Choose your Google account in the next step and allow read-only access to its contacts.
connections.otherContactsHint: Optional. Requests an additional read-only permission for people Google saved outside your main contacts.
connections.readOnly: Connections are read only. Review new matches before applying an import.
connections.retained: Disconnecting retains imported contacts and their source history.
connections.scanFailed: Preparation failed. Your previous completed previews remain available. Reconnect if access has expired, or try preparing the import again.
connections.noChanges: No contact previews in this scan.

return.cancelled: Google connection was cancelled. Open the Google card to try again when you are ready.
return.failed: Google connection could not be completed. Open the Google card to try again.

ready.unsaved: Save your current choices before importing resolved contacts. Reload evidence to discard unsaved choices.
ready.saved_one: Imported {{count}} resolved contact. Contacts requiring review or saved for later remain pending.
ready.saved_other: Imported {{count}} resolved contacts. Contacts requiring review or saved for later remain pending.
